description: Add funds so your agent can keep sending email: returns USDC deposit instructions for its DiviMail balance. It does not move money itself. Use when divimail_balance is low. Returns a NEAR mainnet deposit address plus NEAR Intents links for Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum and Solana; credited automatically within 60 s. Needs a token.

token.description: JWT token from divimail_login, divimail_authenticate or divimail_service_token

name: divimail_request_topup
